# Multi-criteria decision analysis for RAF2021 vehicle selection
import pandas as pd

options = [

}

scores = {
    "Electric Minibus / Shuttle (B2G/B2B)": {
        "Market Demand & Growth (2021-2030)": 8,
        "Competitive Intensity (Higher = Less Intense/Better for New Entrant)": 8,  # Niche market, less dominated by Tesla/VW

        "Capital Intensity & Feasibility (Higher = Lower CapEx/Easier)": 7,        # Low volume, modular platform feasible

    },
    "Electric Cargo Van / LCV (B2B)": {
        "Market Demand & Growth (2021-2030)": 9,                                   # E-commerce delivery boom
        "Competitive Intensity (Higher = Less Intense/Better for New Entrant)": 5,  # High competition (Ford E-Transit, Stellantis, Renault)
        "Regulatory Alignment (EU Green Deal/Clean Vehicles Directive)": 9,
        "Capital Intensity & Feasibility (Higher = Lower CapEx/Easier)": 6,        # Higher volume needed to compete on price
        "Heritage & Brand Alignment (RAF history as minibus king)": 8
    },
    "Passenger EV Sedan/SUV (B2C)": {
        "Market Demand & Growth (2021-2030)": 10,
        "Competitive Intensity (Higher = Less Intense/Better for New Entrant)": 2,  # Extreme competition, price war, high brand barriers
        "Regulatory Alignment (EU Green Deal/Clean Vehicles Directive)": 8,
        "Capital Intensity & Feasibility (Higher = Lower CapEx/Easier)": 3,        # Mass-production scale needed (giga-factories)
        "Heritage & Brand Alignment (RAF history as minibus king)": 3              # RAF not known for passenger cars
    },
    "Hydrogen Fuel Cell Shuttle (B2G)": {
        "Market Demand & Growth (2021-2030)": 5,                                   # Very early stage, infrastructure missing in Baltic/Europe in 2021
        "Competitive Intensity (Higher = Less Intense/Better for New Entrant)": 7,
        "Regulatory Alignment (EU Green Deal/Clean Vehicles Directive)": 8,
        "Capital Intensity & Feasibility (Higher = Lower CapEx/Easier)": 2,        # Extremely high R&D and tech complexity
        "Heritage & Brand Alignment (RAF history as minibus king)": 7
    }
}

results = []

        weighted_score += score * weight
        row[criterion] = score
    row["Weighted Score"] = round(weighted_score, 2)
    results.append(row)

df = pd.DataFrame(results)
df = df.sort_values(by="Weighted Score", ascending=False)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
